description: This PHP source file defines the Upload controller class within the OpenCart admin tool namespace. It handles file upload, listing, download, and delete operations via web requests, including permission checks, file validations, and rendering views. It acts as the backend logic for managing uploaded files in the admin interface.

classes.name: Upload
classes.description: Controller class for handling file uploads, listing, downloading, and deleting within the OpenCart admin interface. Extends the base system controller.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the upload management page with header, footer, and other interface components.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list of uploaded files via AJAX.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns HTML view with the list of uploaded files, applying filters, pagination, and building URLs.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected uploaded files from the server and database after permission check.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Serves a file for download based on provided code, with headers and proper validation.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Handles AJAX file upload, including validation, permission check, and saving file info.
